notes.title: Happy Conquistador coming soon to Steam!
notes.notes:
The “Adult Only” visual novel Happy Conquistador tells the story of Enrique, a Spanish conquistador who embarks on a mission vital for the Spanish Empire. Lead the ship through the ocean, fight for gold and lands, and bring glory to the Spanish Crown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/932b372fa581fefb1899382dde9b0ae9bc8d5c95.jpg[/img]

Our next game, Happy Conquistador, will feature more freedom of choice than you can imagine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/6d3a213f1cc2287e1cb94fcfa028c0fcbaaa6356.jpg[/img]

The main character will visit Arabian peninsula, jungles of Western Africa and a Chinese coastal town. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/b7ebcdea649d9531197321919bf53401a0837f1e.jpg[/img]

He will encounter female companions, engage in romantic (or not so romantic relationships). The CG art, as always, will be presented in form of a gallery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/823c83545c0aa3c2d9a2010014e37b7414313b62.jpg[/img]

Soon, we will be publishing development diaries, where the features of the upcoming game will be presented in detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/95d66502d33043bc6e7d5c3d6f944b224f4e935f.jpg[/img]

We also plan further updates to our first game Meowhalla. The time is not decided yet, but it will likely launch together with the new game’s release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/4a03c42fb056c29db42e327c80a0406a9465464f.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2 is live!
notes.notes:
With the current update we introduced the following changes.

Sprites:

Added fully remade sprites for all characters. 
Existing sprites now change each other more often. 
Astrid’s size was adjusted to correspond to the plot.
Sprites now displayed in two size versions rather than three.

Game changes:
Added new transitions between scenes and some of them were replaced with better alternatives.
Nude versions of some gallery items are placed in-game. (Previously available only in the unlockable gallery)

Sound:
Added explosion sound in the plane. 
Added bonfire sound in the camp.

Other:
Credits now specify, for which part of the game a person was responsible.
Added “options” button to in-game menu. Previously, it was available only in the quick menu.
Added “auto-play” button to the quick menu. The novel can now be read in an auto-mode.

Bug fixes:
Fixed issue when for some players ending screens were covered by dialogue screens.
Fixed typos and formatting in the “Credits” section.
Fixed issue when date and time of save files was not displayed in the Russian version.
Fixed minor typos in the Russian version.

The global version of M.A.I.D.s will cost 6.99 in the Steam store, and you should expect the corresponding prices in the digital distribution in general. notes.title: M.A.I.D.s - Development Diary 3
notes.notes:
Most of graphical assets for the game (M.A.I.D.s) are ready, and we are gradually initiating the process of polishing and testing. Our first build is now bug-free and can be played until the end. As a matter of fact, we will prepare the demo-version of the game, which will be published and available for the download for free when the game is released, or even earlier, if it is possible to show it during a special event. It will contain approx. 5000-8000 words (approx. 10% of the base game). 

Currently, our visual novel is completed as follows:

-	The script is 100% complete (proofreading finished);
-	Sprites are 90% complete (only some sprites for cutscenes remain);
-	Gallery is 95% complete (we are still expecting final arts for the uncensored version);
-	Backgrounds 100% complete;
-	Interface 0% complete (but we plan to hire a designer for it during the next month).

notes.title: M.A.I.D.s Development Diary 2
notes.notes:
M.A.I.D.s is rather a comedy than an erotic game. The gallery, nudity and sex scenes are merely additional features, which are making the game more “alive” and also provide additional interest to those who love this type of content. In turn, we prefer to emphasize the vast satire ranging from the circumstances surrounding the pandemic to the issue of U.S. politics and elections. We laugh about all conflict parties, without taking a side. 

The novel will provide approx. 10 choices, which differ from our previous game (Meowhalla). It was feeling too short because the initial choices led to several different outcomes, which blocked another half of the script. In M.A.I.D.s, we introduced the invisible point system: each choice doesn’t influence the narration but rather only the ending you get. Each ending has approx. 1500-2000 words of unique text (3 endings in total). We are happy to announce that the overall world count has almost reached 70.000 words, more than we have initially expected. The censored version (if we get it approved, it’s still undecided though) will be 5.000 words shorter.

Currently, our visual novel is completed as follows:

-	The script is 100% complete (submitted to the proofreading);
-	Sprites are 30% complete (will be finished in March in full);
-	Gallery is 90% complete (we are still expecting final arts for the uncensored version);
-	Backgrounds 75% complete;
-	Interface 0% complete.

notes.title: Meet the main characters of Meowhalla
notes.notes:
Astrid: the eldest sister, a wise cat woman and a fearless warrior. She is the first Disir sent to the Threshold from Asgard, and she rules these lands with an iron hand. For her, only loyalty and honor matter, and nothing will stop her from following Odin’s orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/14bb3416bd705d41c9e412238b67fa2ad352bba2.png[/img]

Freya: the arrogant and obnoxious sister whose obscure goals are yet unknown. She dreams of luxury and power, and she will try to get as much influence as she can. However, you should really think about allying with her; she sees human males as a tool for the satisfaction of her sexual needs and leaves no place for initiative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/a7749c8fb7418dd7c27a0f1ff3f4a7c758549c96.png[/img]

Olga: the middle sister who is tasked with the military preparation of newcomers. She is a warrior and a scout, always in a perfect physical shape. Few know that Olga has serious daddy issues and would like to be a submissive girl to any newcomer brave enough to try to conquer her heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/e4d274fab0b6882af188e4aa48a933ac3a205287.png[/img]

Inkeri: the most powerful of sisters but completely friendly and innocent. She wants to fight, to drink mead, and to fight again! Inkeri has remained a grown-up child and is absolutely adored by everyone. But in such dark times, you have to keep her safe from a knife in the back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/065d9257ab5834febcee1cf6cd4b6f7d83c110fd.png[/img]

Erica: a young Valkyrie who is capable of traveling among nine worlds. She brought you to the Threshold, but in her heart, she dreams about leaving this place for an incredible lifetime adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/46c9cc253689e7d11425db3d518af88c8032a4af.png[/img]
